0x00121E.en: 「Then, I shall give it my very best.」

0x001289.en: 「I may lack talent, but this is for Lord Shu's sake...」

0x0012C6.en: 「Are you ready?/ Then, shall we begin...」

0x001313.en: 「Now, a fair and square duel, shall we?」

0x001341.en: 「A humble technique, but please accept it.」

0x001378.en: 「Been a while since one so proud. Ready?/ ...Pride goes before a fall, was it?」

0x0013F2.en: 「The Destroyer God Volkruss.../ what a ghastly form...」

0x001451.en: 「Feeble though I may be,/ even I can do something.」

0x0014EA.en: 「Shall I pay a visit in return?」

0x001565.en: 「A cornered rat scratches the cat.../ no, bites the cat, that's it!」

0x0015FC.en: 「Returning the favor/ is only proper etiquette.」

0x00167A.en: 「At least let me strike one blow back.」

0x0017AC.en: 「At this rate, I'll be done for.」

0x0017E9.en: 「How cruel, what a thing to do...」

0x001823.en: 「Augh.../ do go a little easier on me, would you?」

0x00187C.en: 「Ugh.../ I never imagined it'd be this much.」

0x001904.en: 「Ugh! I'm a candle in the wind now...」

0x001944.en: 「Kya...!/　This is getting a bit too dangerous...」

0x0019E7.en: 「Kyu...! N-no!/　No more of this violence... please!」

0x001A93.en: 「Not yet, not yet,/　I won't be beaten so easily, I'll have you know!」

0x001B70.en: 「Auu.../　Maybe I really should have/　just stayed out of this...」

0x001BDF.en: 「Ngh... that's quite a bit of damage.」

0x001C78.en: 「Ugh.../　This one hurts more/　on an emotional level, perhaps.」

0x001CF3.en: 「Kya!/　My, that was less than I feared.」

0x001D99.en: 「Um, I don't think that will work.」

0x001DEC.en: 「Tch!/　That's nothing to me at all!/　...Oh dear, how unladylike.」

0x001E4F.en: 「Did you go easy on me just now?」

0x001E80.en: 「Um... was that supposed to be an attack?」

0x001EC0.en: 「I'm tougher than I look, you know.」

0x001EF7.en: 「This much is no problem for me at all.」

0x001F37.en: 「My, that's merely unpleasant;/　the damage itself was hardly anything.」

0x001FD9.en: 「Kya!/　And what would you have done/　if that had hit me?」

0x002055.en: 「Such a repulsive attack.../　I'd rather not be hit by that.」

0x0020F5.en: 「My, did you miss on purpose?/　How kind of you.」

0x002176.en: 「Looks like I just barely dodged that.」

0x0021E8.en: 「My, I don't have a weapon I can use.」

0x00227E.en: 「I'll clean up the rest for you.」

0x0022F6.en: 「Masaki,/　you've caused me such trouble,/　so consider this payback.」

0x00238A.en: 「Yang Long, I'll gladly lend you my aid.」

0x00243B.en: 「Really, I can't watch this./　I'll do it, Saphine.」

0x0024CE.en: 「Leave it to me, I'll protect you!」

0x002558.en: 「I'm not confident, but.../　I'll shield you somehow!」

0x0025B4.en: 「Now then, Masaki./　Permit me to be helped by... no, to help you.../　um...」

0x002648.en: 「Yang Long, allow me to help you.」

0x0026AA.en: 「...Why must I be the one/　to protect someone like Saphine?」

0x002811.en: 「Those beheld by this eye/　cry out in their death throes!!」

0x0028E3.en: 「Its whisper is like an angel's,/　telling of death at your ear...」
